reasoning: The question asks whether the U.S. will collect between $500b and $1t in customs duties revenue in FY 2025. According to the background, the U.S. collected $82.2b in customs duties in FY 2025. Multiple evidence sources confirm tariff revenues for FY 2025 were approximately $195b (some sources cite $195b, others mention $77b in 2024 vs $195b in 2025). The $82.2b figure appears to be outdated or incomplete. Even using the higher $195b estimate, this falls well below the $500b floor of the specified range. The evidence consistently shows FY 2025 tariff revenues were in the $190-200b range, far short of $500b minimum. Resolution depends on Treasury Department's official FY 2025 Financial Report, but current data strongly indicates the outcome will be below the $500b-$1t range.
